findings.title: S3 bucket with public ACL
findings.description: Bucket ACLs granting public-read, public-read-write, or authenticated-read expose objects beyond the account.
findings.remediation:
Remove the public ACL grant. Set the bucket ACL to private and rely on bucket
policies for access control:
resource "aws_s3_bucket_acl" "this" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.this.id
  acl    = "private"
}
Then enable all four public-access-block settings (see AEGIS-AWS-003 fix).

findings.title: S3 bucket without versioning
findings.description: Versioning protects against accidental deletion and overwrites and is required for reliable recovery. Provider default is disabled.
findings.remediation: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

findings.title: Public S3 exfiltration path
findings.description: An S3 bucket is readable by the public internet through a bucket policy granting s3:GetObject to everyone, or a public ACL: a complete path exists from the internet to the bucket's data.

evidence.expected: private ACL with public access blocked

findings.remediation:
Break the public exfiltration path. Make the S3 bucket private (see AEGIS-AWS-003
fix), remove the overly permissive IAM policy (see AEGIS-AWS-006 fix), and
ensure the compute role cannot reach public buckets. Treat this as an active
incident path: audit CloudTrail for `s3:GetObject` calls from the affected role.

path.detail: anonymous requests from the public internet
bucket data is readable under the public ACL

findings.title: EC2 instance without detailed monitoring
findings.description: With monitoring absent or false (the provider default), the instance ships only basic 5-minute CloudWatch metrics, delaying detection of performance and availability issues.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

findings.title: S3 bucket policy does not enforce TLS (SecureTransport)
findings.description: Without an explicit Deny on aws:SecureTransport=false, bucket objects can be fetched over plaintext HTTP. Add a bucket policy statement denying s3:* when SecureTransport is false.

evidence.expected: bucket policy denying s3:* when SecureTransport is false

findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

findings.title: S3 bucket without server access logging
findings.description: Server access logging records requests against the bucket, which is essential for audit and incident response.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

findings.title: S3 bucket without lifecycle configuration
findings.description: Hygiene: S3 buckets should define lifecycle rules to transition or expire objects, controlling long-term storage costs. Add a lifecycle_rule block or an aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration resource.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: EC2 instance without termination protection
findings.description: disable_api_termination is absent or false, so the instance can be terminated by an accidental or malicious API call. Enable it for instances that must not be deleted casually.

findings.title: EC2 instance without ebs_optimized declared
findings.description: ebs_optimized is absent, so the provider default (false) applies: the instance gets no dedicated EBS bandwidth. Declare ebs_optimized = true on EBS-backed workloads.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: EC2 instance without an IAM instance profile
findings.description: iam_instance_profile is absent, so the instance has no IAM role: any AWS access must come from credentials baked into the image or user_data. Attach an instance profile with least-privilege permissions instead.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

findings.title: EC2 root volume without encryption
findings.description: root_block_device with encrypted absent or false leaves the instance's root volume unencrypted at rest, exposing the OS disk and any data written to it. Set encrypted = true.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

findings.title: EC2 instance without Nitro Enclaves enabled
findings.description: enclave_options is absent, so Nitro Enclaves are unavailable on this instance. Workloads that process sensitive data should enable enclave_options { enabled = true } to isolate it.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
